content: NewsQA: NewsQA BIBREF1 is a dataset very similar to SQuAD. It contains 120.000 human generated questions over 12.000 articles form CNN originally introduced in BIBREF5 . It has been designed to be more challenging than SQuAD with questions that might require to extract multiple spans of text or not be answerable.
